heroSlides.title: NACOSTI Strengthens Research Ethics and Integrity Capacity through Five-day Training
heroSlides.excerpt: The Commission convened a five-day Research Ethics and Integrity Capacity Strengthening Programme bringing together experts, researchers, ethics review committees and universities.

heroSlides.title: Africa Rallies to Inspire Next-Generation Nuclear Scientists
heroSlides.excerpt: Kenya hosted a major regional summit bringing together educators, researchers, policymakers and African scientists to transform public perception and education in nuclear science and technology.

heroSlides.title: IAEA Regional Meeting on Climate, Land-Use, Energy and Water Systems Opens in Nairobi
heroSlides.excerpt: The International Atomic Energy Agency Regional Meeting on the Development of Approaches to Climate, Land-Use, Energy and Water Systems (CLEWS) officially commenced in Nairobi.
